import json

with open('manifest.json') as f:
    m = json.load(f)

# Models
print('=== MODELS ===')
for k, v in m['nodes'].items():
    if v['resource_type'] in ('model', 'test'):
        mat = v.get('config', {}).get('materialized', '?')
        rel = v.get('relation_name', '?')
        uk = v.get('config', {}).get('unique_key')
        ck = v.get('config', {}).get('cluster_by')
        lang = v.get('language', 'sql')
        deps = v.get('depends_on', {}).get('nodes', [])
        ofp = v.get('original_file_path', '?')
        print(f'{k} | mat={mat} | rel={rel} | uk={uk} | ck={ck} | lang={lang} | deps={deps} | file={ofp}')

# Sources
print()
print('=== SOURCES ===')
for k, v in m.get('sources', {}).items():
    rel = v.get('relation_name', '?')
    print(f'{k} | rel={rel}')

# Child map
print()
print('=== CHILD_MAP (models only) ===')
cm = m.get('child_map', {})
for k in sorted(cm.keys()):
    if k.startswith('model.'):
        print(f'{k} -> {cm[k]}')

# Exposures
print()
print('=== EXPOSURES ===')
for k, v in m.get('exposures', {}).items():
    print(f'{k}: {v.get(\"depends_on\", {}).get(\"nodes\", [])}')
"
